intro.text: A major river of Lossand on Dayside. Rising in the KraeDa mountains, it runs south through the heart of the nation to the Southern Border Ocean.

description.text: Its Kerztian name means "The Vein of Cursed Waters": Kerztians consider so much water in one place unholy and usually avoid going near it.

Away from the river most of Lossand is barren, because its sand is too shallow for dorim vines. The river is the nation's main water source, and settlement is possible only along its banks; it allows farming, though the poor soil leaves the grain stunted.

Kezare, Lossand's capital, occupies two islands at the confluence of the Ry'DoAli and the Nor'Tallon, and ferries take passengers and cargo across to the islands from the banks. The river is wide enough for large ships, and smaller settlements line it down to Lraezare at its mouth.
